title: What a Finnish invoice states
source: Arvonlisäverolaki (1501/1993) 209 e § and 209 f § (the simplified invoice up to 400 euros, cited), as Verohallinto's guidance "Laskutusvaatimukset arvonlisäverotuksessa" restates them. Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The seller's Y-tunnus (check digit) and VAT identifier, both parties' names and addresses, number, date, delivery date and the VAT per rate on the page; Käännetty verovelvollisuus and the buyer's VAT identifier for a reverse charge; a credit note names the invoice it amends.
